messages:
rachel (Marketing): Quick ask 10 assets for an upcoming launch push + a one-page inbound routing diagram for SDRs. Need launch-ready by May 10. Low effort, on-brand.

ori (Design): Can do. What exactly? hero 1200x628, three social squares 1080x1080, 1 story 1080x1920, email banner 600x200, claim badge 760x400, and an editable SVG routing map. Also speaker headshots if any.

sam (Growth): Routing should map landing -> form -> lead score -> assign rules -> AE / Growth nurture / Enterprise SDR. Add replay viewers -> nurture only. Need UTM examples and which team owns each path.

mor (Brand): Avoid absolute comparative claims. If using stat callouts, include benchmark source. Use brand-accent-2 for CTAs and icon-set v3. Keep type scale and spacing to system tokens. No custom gradients.

jin (Localization): We need final English strings by May 4 to localize JP & KR by May 7. I can turn around if copy is final.

legal-bot: Numeric percentages need benchmark CSV + run date for approval. Qualitative phrasing is OK now. No superlatives like "the lowest" unless proven.

ori (Design): Figma starter: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/launch-mini-kit 1 frames prefixed "MAY10_LAUNCH". Exports: PNG for images, SVG for diagram (editable layers). I'll include a small UTM snippet on the diagram: `?utm_source=social&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=may10_launch_A`.

rachel (Marketing): Two CTA variants for A/B: A = "See serving savings" B = "Cut inference cost". Sam will map UTMs.

sam (Growth): I'll own the UTM sheet and lead-owner mapping. Will post by May 2. We'll map Variant A -> utm_campaign=may10_A, Variant B -> may10_B.

ori (Design): Timeline: first pass May 1, reviews May 2-3, localization overlays May 4-6, final exports May 8 AM. If copy slips heroes will be text-agnostic so we can overlay later.

mor (Brand): I'll review May 2 for visual alignment and accessibility (contrast).

jin (Localization): Tagging native reviewers for JP/KR.

rachel (Marketing): Thanks team. Ori 1 drop Figma link + checklist when first pass is up. :thumbsup:
